changes.reason: Added the payout stop condition and clarified control destinations and the Governor General exception after comparing every requested part with the relevant summary passage.

answers.answer: 1. Roll one die per held office card simultaneously, adding one per fatigue on that card; Chairman adds one. Modified 1–2: nothing; 3–4: add fatigue; 5+: retire. Move retiree to Pensioners, flip office card to Vacant Offices, and return its fatigue to supply. Commanders have no office card and do not roll normal attrition.

2. Only players who retired at least one pensioner may select or discard a display card. They act by descending actual total retirement spending; ties go to most total windows including new prizes, then clockwise from PM. No replacement occurs during selection; if display empties, remaining eligible players skip. At step end discard all remaining display cards and refill exactly three (prestige faceup, blackmail facedown), even if nobody selected; return all unused Pensioners to supply.

3. At Family phase start check where the opportunity marker was; take the chosen main action once, or twice if marker already matched it, then move marker to the chosen action. Only latest passed extra-action law can grant an extra action after the main action; it is not doubled and does not move marker. With four vacant offices, a doubled Enlist Writer action places three writers total: two for double plus one vacancy bonus, once this turn.

4. After all family actions, while Debt and applicants remain, move the rightmost applicant into Court and lower Debt one; repeat. If Debt is gone, slide remaining applicants as far right as possible preserving order. Seek Share money is paid by the family to the bank, never to Company treasuries.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure / Family / New Company shares

answers.answer: 5. Fill vacancies in ascending number on card backs. Own-family hiring for an ordinary office needs verbal consent of every other player represented in that office’s candidate pool. Chairman elections and Commander appointments are exempt. On promotion, transfer fatigue to the new card and insert old card vacant in ascending order. If candidate or hirer is unavailable, skip it; office stays vacant and takes no actions, including hiring.

6. Former Chairman announces number of shares needed for a pure majority (more than half current shares). Shareholders may campaign; first candidate backed by players controlling that many shares wins. If no candidate succeeds, former Chairman chooses any shareholder including self, without Nepotism consent. The winner’s share piece moves to Chairman slot but remains a Company share for dividends, majority and scoring; it cannot be traded or invested in firms.

7. Commit required resources/cash first; check cash comes from acting office treasury and is paid to bank. Gather dice, subtract penalties, roll and use lowest die: 1–2 success; 3–4 failure, retry if resources and office limits allow; 5–6 catastrophe, no more office actions, return officeholder to supply, discard fatigue and flip card into Vacant Offices. Commander/firm procedures can modify this. Do not take an action with no effect or chance of success (e.g. trade without ship, deploy without dice to possibly lose officers).
answers.evidence: Turn Structure / Company Operation / Success checks

answers.answer: 8. Chairman may add up to three Debt freely, each adding £5 Balance. Each further advance requires consent from players controlling a majority of Company shares (Chairman counts). Never pass end of Debt track. Allocate all Balance to other offices’ treasuries, reducing Balance by each transfer; may interleave borrowing/allocation within borrowing limits. Existing office cash remains there.

9. Manager of Shipping must spend treasury until £2 or less remains. Lease extra ship for £2; fit a ship from a shipyard for £3 without owner consent; buy a Company ship for £5 only if no ships remain on shipyards. Place each acquired ship in any sea zone, including China once established. Extra ships return at Refresh.

10. President declares home region plus only regions reachable through open orders with available ship capacity. Each £1 from that President’s treasury buys one die; subtract one per declared nonhome region. On success, capacity is one order per ship in that Presidency’s sea zone; do not exhaust ships. First writer goes at home port; every next order extends this same Trade’s route. Other Presidency writers cannot extend it. Use all available writers, then filled-order tokens for remaining ships; tokens extend route too. Cannot fill another President’s home region. Balance gains each order’s printed revenue, or half rounded down if a firm filled it this turn; President gets £1 per order and writer owners £1 per writer. At most one successful Trade per President per turn; failed retries remain within uninterrupted opportunity.

11. Commander may target own Presidency home, associated region, or one bordering an associated region; not another home or another Presidency’s Company region. A Company region must have unrest or a closed order to provide an effect. Exhaust chosen officers/regiments for one die each and local alliances for printed dice; subtract target plus all other regions in its empire, target counted once (Company defense strength zero). After each attempt owners roll once per officer exhausted; each 6 removes that officer. Regiments do not roll loss dice.

12. Success loot is £4 per target tower plus faceup loot modifier, minimum surviving participating officers used this attempt plus one for the Commander. Pay Commander family first (£1 for Commander plus £1 per own used surviving officer), then clockwise other families (£1 per their used surviving officer), then bank (£1 per used regiment and each used local-alliance piece regardless of strength); stop each cycle when cash runs out and repeat from Commander until loot is distributed. Commander gets one trophy per target tower. Then remove target tower and dome; if target was an empire capital, remove every matching flag throughout India; open all target orders and remove all unrest. On a new conquest, put loot/control token symbol-side up above associated President’s box, Governor overlay in conquered region and only Governor office card in Vacant Offices for later Hiring. With Governor General, create no Governor or overlay; printed Company symbols indicate control. If Elephant faced outward from conquered region, move it fully inside. Catastrophe: Commander returns half own family trophies rounded up and member to supply; exhausted officers still check losses.

13. Governor rolls current printed pool without penalty per attempt, reducing pool by one after each attempt regardless. On success take £1, or £2 if immediately preceding roll was unsuccessful, then choose exactly one: build ship one stage (first success places partial ship in region; a later success completes it to President’s sea zone), commission a regiment to associated Army, or tax unsplit £2 into Balance or President’s treasury. Each tax after first this turn adds unrest. Any unsuccessful roll adds one regional unrest; catastrophe also removes officeholder. Repeat while dice remain, or until stop/catastrophe.

14. Company pays £1 expense per Debt, each officer/regiment in an Army, and each sea-zone ship including China; not Commanders. If short, take £5 emergency loans, advancing Debt only while a track space remains; at max Debt keep taking loans without advancing. New emergency Debt adds no current expense; after loans set Balance zero. One or two loans lower Standing one, three or more lower it two. Compare remaining Balance to expectations at current Standing; if short lower Standing one. Chairman may then pay affordable dividends at £1 per share, paid each owner £1 per share; if total cash distributed strictly exceeds expectations, raise Standing one.

15. Primary Crisis against Company resolves first; then secondary rebellions in every other unrest Company region, in Bombay→Madras→Bengal Army order, with associated Commander choosing order within Presidency. Primary normal Crisis strength is normal Invasion/Rebellion strength plus target unrest; Foreign Invasion primary uses ordinary die only. Each secondary strength is only its own unrest cubes. Defense: associated Commander chooses/exhausts Army pieces; if vacant Military Affairs acts, and if both vacant Chairman acts; last two gain/lose no trophies. Exhaust active pieces equal to Crisis strength, or as many as possible. Exact equality means attack fails: remove all target unrest, Commander gains trophy, and if normal primary Invasion remove an attacker tower if possible. Unequal means attack succeeds and Region Loss follows; successful primary Invasion also applies empire growth. Whether excess indivisible alliance strength counts as equal is unresolved in summary; strength-2 alliance vs strength-1 attack has no definitive ruling.
answers.evidence: Events / Crisis / Company attacks / Unresolved boundary

answers.answer: 16. Drawn law fails at support −1 or lower: discard law, resolve dilemma “If Failed” if applicable; Opposition Leader returns token and takes PM dial, then new PM moves proposed policy one adjacent space either way and resolves it. Support zero or higher passes: place law with passed laws, PM takes passed-law token, resolve selected policy first then immediate law effects. Finish vote before any failure scoring; restore voting cards afterward.

17. In 1758 and Long 1710, at turn start before London Season PM may call special vote if Standing and/or Debt is on lined space, and must call if either is on starred space. Ordinary voting/support threshold; no policy, PM may oppose. Pass: lower Debt one per two current Debt, set Standing to S, PM takes passed-law token, activate firms. Fail: increase Company-share scoring value by flipping/placing Court VP token up to ±3 VP per share; PM stays and Deregulation law is not discarded. 1813 starts deregulated.

18. Form only if managing no firm: return eligible Company share to supply or flip workshop to invested side, flip board to charter, place member as first firm share, set value cube leftmost and take £5 from bank into London. Invest with manager consent by same share/workshop contribution creating a share and £5 from bank to London; ten-share cap, but further investments still add £5 and no share. No Chairman share; no Company-share investment if Standing or Debt on lined space; cannot use shares created this turn even if traded. Invested workshops stay invested and lose bonus/failure VP.

19. Each firm gets one trade attempt per turn; at least one ship required, and closed home port may be selected, but must be open when filled (selection does not open it). Secret London bid, simultaneous reveal; at Presidency start matching firms reveal strategies and roll one die per £1 bid, bid paid to bank; any 1/2 enables trade. Initiative = ships minus successful dice (may be negative); President’s successful Trade initiative calculated similarly. Fill lowest initiative first, President chooses ties (not automatically first); if President vacant or fails to trade, firms fill after Commander/Governors, Chairman breaks ties. Fill open orders up to ships+1 along own route from home; each firm can fill any order only once itself, but can refill other firm/Company order. Previously filled order pays half rounded down. Advance Value one per full £6 added to India treasury.
answers.evidence: Deregulation / Firm strategies and competing trade

answers.answer: 20. Expenses at Revenue: £1 per charter ship plus higher of share count or firm Value, paid from London and/or India. If unable, dissolve unless rescued. Dissolution sends shares to Debtor’s Prison (−1 VP each), ships to matching shipyards, charter flips to family side; workshops remain invested. After expenses, manager may dividend from India only: each dividend £1 per share plus £1 manager. Waiver needs shareholder choice and manager consent. Record total cash actually paid on Company Balance track; active non-Hobnob paying none records zero, Hobnob keeps old marker. Sweep remaining India money to London.
answers.evidence: Deregulation / Firm expenses, rescue and dividends

answers.answer: 21. Company Balance, VP and Vote tracks are unlimited. Components otherwise limited; when supply runs out, complete as much as possible. Cash, trophy/passed-law tokens, dice and regiments may use proxies. All information including discards and family cash public except facedown blackmail and temporarily concealed firm strategies/bids during selection.

22. Negotiable: enterprises, facedown blackmail, family cash, Company/firm shares, promise cards. Not negotiable: officeholders, writers, officers, prizes, spouses, trophies, passed laws, played blackmail, PM dial, Chairman piece. Transfer share by returning old owner’s family member and placing receiving family member at share’s location. Blackmail must stay facedown when traded; once used faceup it cannot be traded.

23. Immediate transfers bind; future-behavior promises are nonbinding except printed promise card’s guaranteed effect can be called if possible. Calls follow card timing/limits and none during Final Scoring. If simultaneous calls cannot all be fulfilled guarantor chooses which. Promise cards may transfer to third party or back to guarantor. Transferred resources cannot activate twice (e.g., workshop bonus not paid again after sale in same Bonuses phase).

24. Use scenario player setup cards; add three extra cards for five players, six for six; shuffle and deal evenly. Take each card’s listed cash/enterprises/offices/shares/writers/officers/trainees/Commander/ships, including ship in listed zone or on shipyard if unfitted; Commander has no office card. Each starting luxury gives 2 VP. Shuffle prestige and blackmail together as one deck and deal three display cards, prestige faceup and blackmail facedown.

25. Game ends after scenario final turn or when Standing reaches failure. Failure normally immediate; if during Events finish that phase before scoring; if caused by legislation finish vote. Once game over stop negotiation, promise calls and blackmail unless card specifically permits final-scoring use; during all Final Scoring no negotiations or promise calls.

26. Power = enterprises and Company shares at current Power rates (bottom two positions zero), plus passed-law tokens and trophies (+1 each), PM (+2), printed card power including blackmail faceup/down and applicable spouse. Awards depend final turn: 1–3: 3/1 VP, 4–6: 5/2, 7–8: 8/4. Tied first each gets only lower award, no other award; tied second get none. Final VP tie: most windows, then clockwise from PM.

27. Company survived: add Court’s current VP per Company share. Failed: subtract it per share and add 1 VP per uninvested workshop; scores may be negative. Survived final step rolls office attrition then retires pensioners, no display cards; failed instead draws one random Company failure card. Firms score and special retirements happen before Power/other scoring in either outcome.

28. Spouses usually add VP, impose permanent restrictions and cannot transfer. Required enterprise/share trades happen immediately upon taking spouse. Retirement discounts can stack, are personal, and each usable once per London Season and once during Final Scoring.

29. If shipyard returned by Violet Effingham or unpaid tax, its fitted ship remains in play. That shipyard cannot be purchased while matching ship remains in play; purchase becomes possible once ship returns.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure / London Season / Returned shipyard rule

answers.answer: 30. Purchase Luxury: pay bank £4; gain luxury, 2 VP while owned, window icon, social enterprise. Shipyard: £2; take shipyard and put matching ship unfitted on it; shipping enterprise, one vote and £1 bonus while fitted. Workshop: £5; manufacturing enterprise, two votes, £1 bonus; worth 1 VP on Company failure if uninvested. Enlist Writer: member in any Presidency Writers box, plus one extra writer once this turn with ≥4 vacant offices. Enlist Officer: member to Officers-in-Training. Seek Share costs bank £2/£3/£3/£4/£5 by empty queue space; applicant, not share yet.

31. If placing a family piece with none in supply, take one from any prize and lose that prize’s printed VP; applies to firm-share creation too. If no Family action is possible, take none and return opportunity marker to supply.

32. If Court empty, former Chairman automatically returns as Chairman, placing a member from supply or, if necessary and possible, from a prize (lose its VP). If impossible to place, there is no Chairman.

33. Chairman election follows shareholder rule. Chairman chooses Director among current officeholders other than Chairman/Governor; if all offices vacant, any writer. Chairman chooses Shipping any writer; Military Affairs chooses Presidential Commander, else any officer, else any trainee. Director hires President as writer of that Presidency or Governor associated with it. Associated President hires Governor from writer or officer in region (not Commander). Chairman hires China Superintendent from any writer immediately on creation. Governor General replaces Director and is hired same way.

34. Director may make repeated Special Envoy checks costing £1 treasury per die with no penalty. Success opens one closed order in non-Company region or opens China by placing Superintendent overlay/card and Chairman immediately hires writer. After all envoys Director may transfer up to two writers or ships between Presidencies/sea zones (including China once created); cannot transfer until envoys finished.

35. Military Affairs first transfers up to two officers/regiments between Armies, remaining in top half; then assigns every trainee to any Army’s top half; finally appoints Commanders. Appoint if vacancy or a family has more total pieces in Army than incumbent; choose among families with most pieces. Move chosen officer to Commander slot; previous Commander returns to top as officer. Tie with incumbent does not replace. Nepotism does not apply.

36. Each President chooses sequence of its Commander, Governors and Trade; each may decline, and each position finishes all actions before next (Trade cannot interrupt). Trade may be placed before/after any. If President vacant, Chairman sets order only; cannot Trade or approve local alliance purchases.

37. Trade itself never exhausts ships. On Refresh writers return to their associated Presidency Writers box using dividers to preserve affiliation; filled tokens and Presidency dividers return to supply.

38. At start of Commander operations, before Deploy, request President treasury funds for printed-price local alliances in Army; President must approve. Purchased alliances enter active/top. Used for Deploy/defense, exhaust whole alliance to bottom; strength can be used once and cannot split between purposes. Refresh exhausts any unused active alliances and does not reactivate alliances (though officers/regiments reactivate).

39. Against own Company region defense penalty zero; target must still have unrest or closed order for effect. No tower means zero tower trophies. With no tower or faceup loot modifier, minimum loot is surviving participating officers +1 for Commander, distributed normally.
answers.evidence: Actions / Commanders and Deploy / Company regions

answers.answer: 40. Two successful Governor Build actions (each success is one stage): first places partial ship in Governor region if none there; next completes it into sea zone associated with Governor’s President. Governor commission puts regiment in associated President’s Army; regiment has officer-like strength, loot paid to bank, and no officer-loss rolls.

41. China created by successful envoy or Envoy to China law; either way Chairman immediately hires any writer. Treasury holds ships, not cash; Shipping/Director may send ships there as a sea zone. After Bengal it acts; ships assigned there count Eastern for expenses, events, storms and laws.
answers.evidence: Actions / Superintendent of Trade in China

answers.answer: 42. China may attempt only once, including failed check; no retry. Do not attempt without export icon among Company-controlled regions. Roll one die per ship. Success: Company Balance gets £4 times number of export icons in all Company-controlled regions; Superintendent family gets £1 per same icon from bank. Non-Company region icons do not count.
answers.evidence: Actions / Superintendent of Trade in China

answers.answer: 43. Governor General law makes Governors pensioners, removes overlays and partial ships, returns Governor/Director cards to box. Replace Director with Governor General preserving holder and fatigue and ribbon overlay. Subsequent conquests create no Governors/overlays; Company symbols show control. On region loss skip Governor elimination.

44. First add £3 Balance per Company region. May Govern repeatedly, paying £1 treasury per die, no penalty, max one successful Govern per turn. Every rolled 6 adds unrest to every Company region even on success; failure adds another unrest to each. On success gain £1 per Company region and choose one benefit per region: complete Company ship to any sea zone incl. China, regiment to any Army, or £2 to Balance/any office treasury except own, adding unrest to a Company region. Multiple Tax choices this turn put unrest in different regions.

45. Only player-owned ships in affected zones check storms; roll once per eligible ship: 1–2 nothing, 3–4 fatigue or sink if already fatigued, 5–6 sink. Company and extra ships exempt. China ships count Eastern; firm ships use their strategy zone; Hobnob firm ships exempt. Sunk ship returns to shipyard unfatigued.

46. Writer on newly closed order returns to owner’s supply; filled token flips to closed. If told to close in fully closed region, Cascade: close all open orders directly connected; if a connected order already closed, close that region’s northernmost open order instead. If none open, it too Cascades. Region may initiate Cascade only once per event tile but can receive multiple Cascade effects.

47. Turmoil closes northernmost open order in top-stack region; if all closed, Cascade. Windfall pays owners £1 per writer on orders in top-stack region and every bordering region. Shuffle: March Elephant, shuffle this tile into remaining draw stack, separately shuffle discards and place them on top. If draw stack empty, March last instead.

48. Leader uses top-stack region. Sovereign region gains one tower. Dominated region instead rebels with printed explosion modifier. March only if Elephant was fully inside a Company region that successfully rebelled.

49. If Elephant across border, Peace opens orders connected across its border and adds one tower to each touched non-Company region; then March. If fully within a region, instead open all its orders and remove its unrest; then March.

50. Invasion compares attacker whole-empire strength plus event modifier with defender whole-empire strength; must be strictly greater (equal fails). Success replaces defender flag with attacker dominated flag; taking capital shatters defender empire. If attacker had no empire, use available capital/star and matching small flag; if none, no empire/flags form. Failure attacker loses one tower.

51. Rebellion compares only rebelling region strength plus modifier to sovereign capital strength; other empire regions do not count. Must be strictly greater; tie fails. Success makes actor sovereign, removes its flag and closes all its orders (Cascade if already closed); failure removes one tower from capital.

52. Region Loss returns Commander half family trophies rounded up and Commander to supply; roll once per associated Army officer, each 6 removes officer. Eliminate Governor (card to unused stack, fatigue/member to supply, remove overlay); remove partial ship and unrest. Restore dome with one tower (or Foreign Invasion specified strength) and appropriate flag; return control token to region £ loot side down, region symbol up. Region loses Presidency association. Orders close for Invasion Crisis (Cascade if all closed); Rebellion/Foreign Invasion already close. Standing loss escalates by regions lost this turn: first −1, second additional −2, etc. No other Company region is automatically lost; resolve each attack separately.

53. After successful Invasion Crisis, Elephant moves to successful capital (Imperial Ambitions); otherwise it goes to top-stack region. If Company region, place fully inside; dominated, point toward sovereign; sovereign, point across shape-marked border on tile. If that neighbor dominated by actor, choose first clockwise neighbor not dominated; if all are, use redirect-arrow border pointing toward empire capital.

54. Storm die chooses target: West Bombay, South Madras, East Bengal; all storms means each; none means top-stack region. Per target roll ordinary die for attack strength and resolve Invasion/Company attack. Success closes all orders (Cascade if already all closed), removes target flag and all matching flags if capital, restores dome if Company-controlled, sets towers to half attack die rounded down. March with circle shape only if Elephant fully inside Company region invaded. Foreign Invasion primary adds no unrest to die strength or towers; normal Company defense and secondary unrest attacks still apply.

55. PM draws at least one law. After one or two ordinary non-dilemma draws, may stop or continue to three total; choose one revealed, discard others. Drawing dilemma forces its selection and ends drawing. Before vote move dial clockwise/counterclockwise, stopping at first policy space matching chosen law’s bottom icon; that determines target/consequence.

56. Tax: each family pays bank £1 per target it owns; unpaid target returns supply, including Chairman if taxed. Window tax additionally charges each window on enterprises and each family member’s prize; unaffordable item/member returns. Bonus: bank pays each family £1 per target owned. Power: swap target Power marker with next higher; if already highest, swap any other pair.

57. Starting PM clockwise, players buy votes with £1 family cash each plus card votes. Each card’s votes can be used only once entire vote across rounds; rotate when used until resolution. PM may call another full round or stop after each; round with no votes ends voting.

58. Supporter may later oppose; once opposed cannot support again this vote. Opposition Leader is biggest opponent; tied current holder keeps token. With recipient consent votes may be cast on behalf of someone already opposed or committing to oppose, adding to their opposition total. PM cannot oppose or consent to enterprises opposing except forced “Vote with my enterprises” promise.

59. Final turn still pays upkeep for each prize member; if unpaid return member and lose prize VP. Help negotiation allowed while game continues. On nonfinal turn Refresh: writers to associated Presidency boxes, filled tokens/dividers and extra ships to supply; exhausted officers/regiments reactivate; active alliances exhaust (not reactivate); fitted player ships keep fatigue; advance turn and begin London Season. Final turn skips Refresh and scores.

60. In deregulated game each shareholder may make one additional retirement per London Season from supply, regardless of number of firms owned. Actual post-discount cash spent may not exceed highest total dividend marker of any firm where they own share; printed prize cost may exceed marker if discount covers difference. Cannot retire from firm with absent/zero marker. Normal retirement rules and prestige eligibility apply. At start Final Scoring, first score firms, then each eligible shareholder may special-retire once whether Company survives/fails; no display cards.

61. Investment: bank pays £5 into firm London treasury; London pays for ship acquisition, trade bids and expenses; India receives trade proceeds and pays dividends/expenses. Family cash cannot enter/leave firm treasuries. Only specified investment/payout/expense procedures transfer firm cash.

62. Firms phase after Family share creation and before Hiring; investments occur without set order until no one wishes, then strategies chosen. Manager decides timing conflicts within firm; PM resolves conflicts between firms.

63. Firm may fit ship from own or another player’s shipyard only with shipyard owner consent, paying £3 from London to bank. May buy player-owned ship already in Company with owner consent: £3 unfatigued or £2 fatigued, paid into Shipping treasury. Firms cannot acquire Company or extra ships.

64. Only player managing no firm may initiate takeover; managing another also disqualifies. Need consent of holders of majority of target shares. Move firm ships, money and shares to own charter, copy both cube positions; former manager returns cubes and flips board to family side.

65. Merger requires managers to negotiate with every shareholder’s consent. Highest-value firm primary; tie, players choose. Transfer secondary shares, ships, treasury funds to primary; secondary boards return to family side; shareholders may negotiate share transfers. If primary exceeds ten shares, excess shares returned to their owners’ supplies with those owners’ consent. Primary Value/dividend track continues.
66. Hobnob has no bid, trade or dividends; pays expenses and retains prior dividend marker for retirement. Hobnob ships are exempt from storms.

67. Yes, even at ten shares investments still contribute £5 to London, without creating shares. Emergency investments use normal Company-share/workshop rules, including same-turn-created-share prohibition. Emergency rescue pays expenses, loses any remaining cash and lowers Value one space per emergency investment. Invested workshop remains invested.

68. Emergency negotiated merger is with only one other firm. Normal merger process still applies, including consent of every involved shareholder. Other firm first pays its own expenses if not already paid, then covers endangered firm’s unpaid expenses.

69. Voluntary dissolution requires all shareholders’ consent and uses insolvent dissolution procedure: shares to Debtor’s Prison (−1 VP each), ships to matching shipyards, charter flips to family side. Workshops remain invested for rest of game.

70. Before ordinary scoring, for each player separately add VP from all shares across all firms then round that player total down once; deduct 1 VP per own family piece in Debtor’s Prison. Firm Value rates per share: 1 −1; 2 0; 3–4 ½; 5–7 1; 8–9 1½; 10 2. Apply regardless of Company survival/failure; Company shares/workshop scoring handled later based on outcome.
72. 1710 turns 1–5; Long 1710 turns 1–8 and deregulation available separately; 1758 turns 3–7 and may vote deregulation; 1813 turns 5–8 and starts deregulated.

73. 1710: Standing £10 expectations, Debt 0, each office £3, Royal Protection, one regiment per Army, no Company ships. 1758: Standing £12 expectations, Debt 3, each office £4, Calico Acts, one regiment per Army, one Company ship Eastern, Bengal control token in Bengal Presidency.

74. 1813: turns 5–8, Standing £10 expectations, Debt 0, each office £3; laws Military Oversight, Deregulation (Debtor’s Prison side), Calico Acts; two regiments each Army, one Company ship each sea zone. Put +2/−2 share-value token in Court, create China, add Bombay/Madras/Bengal control tokens to Presidencies, return Governor General law to box and place overlay over Director of Trade; use Governor General not Director and no Governors. Copy exact map from card reverse.
75. Power awards: final turns 1–3 first/second 3/1 VP; 4–6 5/2; 7–8 8/4. Tied first each gets only lower award; no second award to others in that tie.

76. Initial Power: Social 2, Company shares 1, Shipping and Manufacturing 0. Standing expectations track £4/6/8/10/12/14/16; S reset above £10. Deregulation Standing £4/6/8 and Debt 5/6/7/8 lined; Standing £4 and Debt 8 starred.

77. No. Foreign Invasion uses ordinary attack die without unrest added, both for attack and resulting tower halving. On success close all target orders once; if already all closed, Cascade; Region Loss does not close again.

78. Mercantile/Diplomatic Connection reducing check to zero dice means failure. Company Fraud at start of Revenue rolls one die per your officeholder, reduces Balance by twice highest roll (minimum zero), and bank pays only actual Balance reduction, not a larger theoretical amount. Public Demands Impeachment returns member to supply and office card to vacancies. Military Oversight demotes Commander to officer then appoints from officers; same former Commander remains eligible.

79. Set Balance £5, Power tokens at indicated starting spots, family VP zero, local alliances in named Army boxes, loot money-side up in matching regions. Choose scenario card for Standing, Debt, treasuries, laws, regiments, ships and India political map; place Turn marker on scenario date and PM dial arm to matching date.

80. Turn order: London Season → Family → Firms (if deregulated) → Hiring → Company Operation → Bonuses → Revenue → Events in India → Parliament Meets → Upkeep and Refresh. Eligible special Deregulation vote occurs at turn start before London Season. Skip London Season first turn.

81. Retirement order starts with Chairman, or former Chairman if office vacant, then clockwise. Each may retire each pensioner to a prize; optional, pay printed cost, move member to prize and gain printed VP. Set actual spending aside until London ends to determine display order, then pay bank. Pensioners not used return to supply after display.
82. No. Whenever empire loses its last dominated region, remove surviving capital’s starred flag so it is no longer an empire. Applies regardless of cause, including Rebellion or Company conquest.
83. Value 1 −1 VP/share; 2 0; 3–4 ½ each; 5–7 1 each; 8–9 1½ each; 10 2 each.

84. Chairman title holder acts first in Family; others clockwise. New Company shares step occurs after all family actions; while Debt and applicants remain move rightmost applicant into Court, lowering Debt one each time.

85. Red ribbon: Chairman → Director of Trade or Governor General → Manager of Shipping → Military Affairs → Bombay → Madras → Bengal → China Superintendent if created. Skip vacant offices; vacant office takes no action. Within Presidency President chooses order of its Commander, Governor(s), Trade.

86. Storm die first determines zones and number of India events. Resolve all storm checks before any event draw. Exempt Company/extra ships; eligible player ships in affected zone, China as Eastern, firms in strategy zone except Hobnob. Roll once each: 1–2 nothing, 3–4 fatigue or sink if fatigued, 5–6 sink. Then draw/resolve one tile at a time for number on die.
answers.evidence: Events in India / Storms and event sequence

answers.answer: 87. For ordinary Elephant-located Crisis, tail is acting/attacker, head defender. Sovereign actor (large capital flag or unflagged dome) means Invasion; dominated actor (small flag or no dome) rebels against sovereign. Elephant fully inside Company region means Rebellion against Company.
